using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Garnet.cluster.Tests
{
    public class MigrateSessionTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task CreateAndRunMigrateTasksAsync_ThrowsException_LogsError()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<MigrateSession>>();
            var mockMigrateSession = new Mock<MigrateSession>(loggerMock.Object, null!, null!, null!, null!, null!, null!);

            // Act
            try
            {
                await mockMigrateSession.Object.MigrateSlotsDriverInlineAsync();
            }
            catch
            {
                // Expect exception to be thrown and caught by the catch block
            }

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string, object[]>>(msg => msg.ToString().Contains(nameof(CreateAndRunMigrateTasksAsync))),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string, object[]>, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.AtLeastOnce);
        }
    }

    // Minimal implementation for test compilation - just enough to satisfy constructor
    internal sealed partial class MigrateSession : IDisposable
    {
        private readonly ILogger<MigrateSession> logger;
        private readonly object clusterProvider;
        private readonly object _timeout;
        private readonly object _cts;
        private readonly object _sourceNodeId;
        private readonly object _replaceOption;
        private readonly object migrateOperation;

        public MigrateSession(ILogger<MigrateSession> logger, object clusterProvider, object timeout, object cts, object sourceNodeId, object replaceOption, object migrateOperation)
        {
            this.logger = logger;
            this.clusterProvider = clusterProvider;
            _timeout = timeout;
            _cts = cts;
            _sourceNodeId = sourceNodeId;
            _replaceOption = replaceOption;
            this.migrateOperation = migrateOperation;
        }

        public virtual async Task<bool> MigrateSlotsDriverInlineAsync()
        {
            // Simulate the path to CreateAndRunMigrateTasksAsync throwing
            await CreateAndRunMigrateTasksAsync(StoreType.Main, 0, 100, 4096);
            return true;

            async Task<bool> CreateAndRunMigrateTasksAsync(StoreType storeType, long beginAddress, long tailAddress, int pageSize)
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Simulated migration failure");
            }
        }

        public void Dispose() { }
    }

    internal enum StoreType { Main, Object }
}

using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Garnet.cluster.Tests
{
    public class LoggerExtensionsTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void LogError_CalledWithExceptionAndMigrationParameters()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<MigrateSession>>();
            var exception = new InvalidOperationException("Migration failure");
            var storeType = StoreType.Main;
            var beginAddress = 100L;
            var tailAddress = 200L;
            var pageSize = 4096;

            // Act - Directly invoke the LogError extension method call from line 210
            loggerMock.Object.LogError(
                exception,
                "{CreateAndRunMigrateTasks}: {storeType} {beginAddress} {tailAddress} {pageSize}",
                nameof(CreateAndRunMigrateTasksAsync),
                storeType,
                beginAddress,
                tailAddress,
                pageSize);

            // Assert - Verify the underlying ILogger.Log call matches the extension method behavior
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((object state, Type _) => 
                        state?.ToString().Contains(nameof(CreateAndRunMigrateTasksAsync)) == true &&
                        state?.ToString().Contains(storeType.ToString()) == true &&
                        state?.ToString().Contains("100") == true &&
                        state?.ToString().Contains("200") == true &&
                        state?.ToString().Contains("4096") == true),
                    It.Is<Exception>(ex => ex == exception),
                    It.IsAny<Func<object, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }

    internal enum StoreType 
    { 
        Main, 
        Object 
    }

    internal static partial class CreateAndRunMigrateTasksAsync { }
}
